Ever since Bill Clinton and Newt Gingrich got together to dismantle the welfare state, welfare has been set up to help the indigent until they can get back on their feet.

Provided you are not mentally ill, welfare can help someone who has hit hard time with food and shelter until they can get back on their feet. Welfare is a highly volatile political issue and drives some people bat shit, but it is the price we all pay as citizens of the United States. We are indeed our brothers keeper whether we like it or not. People with a sense of morality may not like it. But they do understand. If you are without education, skills, or are mentally ill, you are fucked and welfare will probably help you for a little while with some food and shelter, but it is by no means going to help you be a productive member of society.
